Pakistan Sports Control Board Rules 1962
Pakistan Sports Control Board Rules 1962
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, 10th May 1962]
S. R. O. 509 (K)/62. In exercise of the powers conferred by section
4 of the Sports (Development and Control) Ordinance, 1962 (XVI of 1962), the
Central Government is pleased to make the following rules for determining the
constitution, powers and functions of the Pakistan Sports Control Board
constituted under section t3 of the said Ordinance.
1. Short title and commencement. (I)
These rules may be called the Pakistan Sports Control
Board Rules, 1962.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Definitions. In these rules,
unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,
(a) "Board" means the
Pakistan Sports Control Board constituted under section 3 of the Sports
(Development and Control) Ordinance, 1962 (XVI of 1962) ;
(b) "Executive
Committee" means the Executive Committee of the Board ;
(c) "member"
means a member of the Board ;
(d) "national
sports organisation" means an organisation constituted on a national basis for
controlling sports and recognised as such by the Board
;
(e) "President" means
the President of the Board and includes the Vice‑ President
; and
(f) "sports"
does not include horse-racing.
3. Terms of office of the members.-(1)
A member
who is a represen tative of a national sports organisation
shall hold office as long as he continues to represent that national sports organisation by virtue of his office in the organisation.
(2) The nominated, other than the
ex-officio members,
shall, unless sooner removed by the Central Government, hold office for a term
of two years and shall be eligible for re-nomination.
4. Headquarters. The Board shall
have its headquarters at such place as may be determined by the Central
Government.
5. Functions of the Board. The following
shall be the functions of the Board, namely :----
(a) To promote and develop
standards of national fitness as well as standards of competition comparable to
the international standards ;
(b) To make the public sports-
conscious and to encourage their participation in national and international
sporting events ;
(c) To assist and guide the
national sports organisations in executing their programmes of sporting activities ;
(d) To encourage training and
coaching of national teams for international matches ;
(e) To approve the budget of the Board ;
(f) To appoint sub-committees as,
and when it thinks fit and fix heir terms of reference ;
(g) To encourage, promote and
undertake such measures as would assist
in the development of sports in Pakistan ;
(h) To collect, accept or otherwise receive from any
person, body, association or organisation any
subscription, donation, assistance or help either in money, land or by transfer
in favour of the Board ; and
(i) To
manage, improve or otherwise supervise, any property, movable or immovable,
with all necessary powers, in the interests of the Board.
6. Meetings. (1) The Board shall meet at least once in every calendar year
when a report on the activities and accounts of the board shall be placed
before the members.
(2) To constitute a quorum at a meeting of the Board, not
less than one-third of the total number of members shall be present.
(3) The President or, in his
absence, the Vice-President, shall preside at all meetings of the Board and of
the Executive Committee.
(4) At the meetings of the Board
and the Executive Committee each member shall have one vote and, in the event
of equality of votes, the President shall have a second or casting vote.
7. Funds. (1)
The Board shall have its own fund.
(2) The sources of income of the
Board shall be the following, namely :
(a) Grants-in-aid from the
Central Government ;
(b) Collections and donations
from any person, body, association or organisation.
(3) All the funds and money of
the Board shall be kept in the National Bank of Pakistan.
